description: This file defines various service protocols related to device functionalities such as camera, screen recording, location, device status, photos, contacts, calendar, reminders, motion, and watch messaging. It declares protocols, type aliases, and some class extensions, serving as a protocol layer for device services in an iOS application.

classes.name: CameraController
classes.description: An extension that makes CameraController conform to the CameraServicing protocol.

classes.name: ScreenRecordService
classes.description: An extension that makes ScreenRecordService conform to the ScreenRecordingServicing protocol.

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: An extension that makes LocationService conform to the LocationServicing protocol.
